data.narrative: This SAR is filed based on confirmed structuring and layering activity involving multiple accounts under common beneficial ownership (CUST-20015, Viktor Petrov). Over a 48-hour period, $284,750 was moved through a network of three domestic accounts (ACC-10042, ACC-10088, ACC-10099) before being distributed to offshore entities in Cyprus and UAE. Transactions were deliberately structured below $10,000 to avoid CTR reporting, with rapid velocity and use of high-risk MCCs including cryptocurrency (6051) and money transmission (6012). External fraud database queries confirmed the customer's email is linked to prior 314(b) requests and a synthetic identity ring. Graph analysis revealed shared registered agents and round-tripping patterns. Accounts ACC-10042 and ACC-10088 have been frozen, a wire recall initiated for $9,950 transfer to Pacific Trade Holdings (Hong Kong), and a chargeback filed for $14,750 to CryptoXchange Ltd. No customer notification beyond freeze notice was provided. Law enforcement has been informally alerted pending SAR filing.
